workflows.title: Lead Follow-Up Autopilot
workflows.summary: Captures WhatsApp inquiries in Google Sheets, sends syllabus, and follows up in 24h.
workflows.triggerDescription: When an inquiry arrives on WhatsApp

steps.label: Save customer to Google Sheets student roster
Deliver lesson brochure to prospective student on WhatsApp
Wait 24h & check if lesson booked on Google Calendar
Book session & create Google Meet link
Send M-Pesa payment prompt for KES 3,500 via Paybill 849201

operationalFlow.title: Customer sends a WhatsApp message
operationalFlow.description: Student reaches out inquiring about French lessons or pricing packages.

operationalFlow.title: Otomatizon identifies a new inquiry
operationalFlow.description: Extracts contact information, verifies student status, and initiates the automated process.

operationalFlow.title: Customer information is recorded in Google Sheets
operationalFlow.description: Student name, WhatsApp phone number, and inquiry timestamp are appended to your active roster.

operationalFlow.title: Course information is sent automatically
operationalFlow.description: Rate sheet, exam syllabus brochure, and Google Calendar booking link are dispatched instantly.

operationalFlow.title: Google Calendar is checked
operationalFlow.description: Monitors your calendar availability to detect whether the student confirmed a lesson slot.

operationalFlow.title: If no booking exists after 24 hours, Otomatizon follows up
operationalFlow.description: Evaluates booking confirmation status after the 24-hour waiting period.
operationalFlow.conditionText: Has student confirmed a lesson on Google Calendar?

branchOutcome.no: Send polite check-in message on WhatsApp

operationalFlow.title: The follow-up stops when customer books or replies
operationalFlow.description: A Google Calendar invite with Meet link is confirmed, and an M-Pesa payment prompt is sent.

opportunities.title: 14 leads were not followed up
opportunities.problem: You're losing leads between inquiry and booking.
opportunities.evidence: We found 23 inquiries with inconsistent follow-up across WhatsApp and Gmail.
opportunities.recommendation: Automatically follow up after 24 hours when a lead hasn't booked.
opportunities.suggestedWorkflowDescription: Saves inquiry to Sheets, delivers syllabus, sends 24h follow-up.

opportunities.title: 6 lessons completed without payment
opportunities.problem: Students attend lessons but payment is collected days later.
opportunities.evidence: 6 calendar sessions lack matching M-Pesa receipts within 24 hours.
opportunities.recommendation: Automatically send M-Pesa STK push 18 hours before scheduled sessions.
opportunities.suggestedWorkflowDescription: Checks calendar, sends M-Pesa reminder, confirms payment receipt.
